# U20: Load a spreadsheet from Data: a new goal, then its past weeks, with every change shown before saving

- **Belongs to:** the Spreadsheets module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `BULK-IMPORT`, `SPREADSHEETS-ON-DATA`
- **Budget:** at most 15 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Mateo, at `/data` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U20

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Mateo (`mateo`).
- _Note:_ Spreadsheets live on Data (the spreadsheets module): Export, a menu, and Import, a link (import spec 2.9).
- Go to `/data` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the data import in the data tools (`.data-tools .data-import`) is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** (`parity`) met when `(await menu.innerText()).trim() === 'Export' && (await link.innerText()).trim() === 'Import'`, where `const menu = p.locator('.data-export > summary')`; `const link = p.locator('.data-tools .data-import')`. Else it says: Data's tools say “{(await menu.innerText()).trim()}” and “{(await link.innerText()).trim()}”.
- **Step.** Press the data import in the data tools (`.data-tools .data-import`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import”.
- **Check:** “Add or change goals, plans, check-ins and people from a spreadsheet.” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “import”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ A new goal, linked by name.
- Choose “goals.csv” to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `csv('goals.csv', 'Goal,Owner,Type,Unit,Start,Target,Feeds into\nRunbooks with an owner,Mateo Fernández,metric,%,20,90,Change failure rate\n')`, where `const csv = (name, text) => ({ name, mimeType: 'text/csv', buffer: Buffer.from(text) })`.
- **Check:** “1 new goal” is shown.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “preview”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Save 1 change” button.
- **Check:** “Saved 1 row from goals.csv.” is shown.
- _Note:_ Its past weeks, by the old address (it leads to Data's Import): a week in the future is refused, and nothing saves until it's fixed.
- Go to `/import` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import”.
- Choose “history.csv” to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `` csv('history.csv', `Goal,Week,Value\nRunbooks with an owner,${NOW - 3},20\nRunbooks with an owner,${NOW - 2},20\nRunbooks with an owner,${NOW + 2},20\n`) ``, where `const csv = (name, text) => ({ name, mimeType: 'text/csv', buffer: Buffer.from(text) })`; `NOW` is 45.
- **Check:** “hasn’t happened yet” is shown (else: a future week was not refused).
- _Note:_ With a row to fix, the preview's one action is choosing the corrected file: there is no Save to press.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “Save” button is not there (else: Save was offered with a row that needs fixing).
- **Step.** Press the “Choose the corrected file” button.
- Choose “history.csv” to load in the “Choose a spreadsheet” field; the file is `` csv('history.csv', `Goal,Week,Value\nRunbooks with an owner,${NOW - 3},20\nRunbooks with an owner,${NOW - 2},20\n`) ``, where `const csv = (name, text) => ({ name, mimeType: 'text/csv', buffer: Buffer.from(text) })`; `NOW` is 45.
- **Check:** “2 check-ins (2 for past weeks)” is shown.
- **Step.** Press the “Show the 2 changes” link.
- **Check:** A change in the import’s preview shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) there are 2 of a change in the import’s preview showing “Runbooks with an owner” (else: the changes do not name the goal).
- **Step.** Press the “Save 2 changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/data/import/done/imp_”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!!g && g.parentId === 'ns-cfr' && cis.length === 2 && cis.every((c) => c.backfilled)`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const g = s.goals.find((x) => x.title === 'Runbooks with an owner')`; `const cis = s.checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === g?.id)`. Else it says: the goal or its past weeks were not saved.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'workspace' && c.action === 'imported' && /Loaded a spreadsheet/.test(c.summary)) && s.changes.filter((c) => c.goalId === g?.id).every((c) => c.diffs.some((d) => d.field === 'Via' && d.to === 'Spreadsheet'))`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const g = s.goals.find((x) => x.title === 'Runbooks with an owner')`. Else it says: the import was not logged as coming from a spreadsheet.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
